retained_constraints: Inspect habitat/inbox/scout, habitat/outbox/scout, and habitat/memory/scout directories for queued items and unprocessed messages.
Review .github/workflows/janus-git-habitat-scout.yml on the control_plane (main branch) to validate workflow triggers, permissions, and secrets access.
Query GitHub Actions for run IDs (e.g., 32530849442, 32427785558) to confirm run statuses and logs.
Verify access and integrity of the authoritative Aura SQLite store at Hawkar-usls/Hawkar-usls:state/aura_spi_dialogue.sqlite3 (per manifest).
Determine whether a persistent executor (NAS/PC) is available or scheduled to satisfy the Spiral receipt's next_gate requirement.
